name: Trilinear Interpolation for X-ray Attenuation Approximation
aliases: Interpolatory quadrature via the rectangular rule
definition: A fast approximation of the Beer-Lambert law using trilinear interpolation to sample the voxelgrid, implemented as interpolatory quadrature via the rectangular rule. It is linear in the number of sample points $M$.
summary: Trilinear interpolation for X-ray attenuation approximation is a fast, differentiable method that uses trilinear interpolation and the rectangular rule to approximate line integrals, trading precision for speed and regularization in sparse-view CBCT reconstruction.
